query.description: Optional provider-specific query used to select logs. Leave empty to aggregate logs without a text filter.

bucket_size.description: The duration of each aggregation bucket, for example 5m

operator.description: How terms in the log query are combined. Facet filters are always combined with AND.

facets.description: The facets used to filter logs

start.description: The start time in ISO8601 format

end.description: The end time in ISO8601 format
